test_title: PYST 186: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'DOCTOR' is written as 'SQWGTJ' and 'SINGER' is written as 'SGJRNY'. How will 'TAILOR' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f390eb1aa5eef27c267010a8106c7b83cfbeaa1b6c945402f538a1e70a0d41b.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'DOCTOR' is written as 'SQWGTJ'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f518b3f714cec859bde16991752ea5473b23bfa579eeca1b8617e42c9f3b77f.png] 

And

'SINGER' is written as 'SGJRNY'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6cb80af618fddf6d1d2f05ecb4849ab312567f29ddd820e3c31afb62d72fd8a.png] 

Similarly,

'TAILOR' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0cc1e9cefce4a033d809c37f32ed2a488adf7d5dd4abf79eccef631dc5bb51f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SQOMFZ".**
